scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:frontend && pnpm run check:tauri
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.check:frontend: pnpm -C frontend run lint && pnpm -C frontend run typecheck && pnpm -C frontend run test && pnpm -C frontend run build
scripts.check:tauri: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.release:verify: pnpm baseline && pnpm check && pnpm run tauri:build:no-bundle
